#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/ji-stage6-failed-health"
if test -d "$root"; then
  docker run --rm -v "$root:/ji-cleanup" alpine:3.22 sh -eu -c 'rm -rf /ji-cleanup/* /ji-cleanup/.[!.]* /ji-cleanup/..?*'
  rmdir "$root"
fi
mkdir -p "$root/runtime" "$root/output"
tar -xzf "$HOME/ji-stage6-release/output/ji-host-linux-amd64-java21-final.tar.gz" -C "$root/runtime"
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 71\n' > "$root/runtime/ji-host/bin/ji-host"
chmod 0755 "$root/runtime/ji-host/bin/ji-host"
tar -czf "$root/output/ji-host-failed-health.tar.gz" -C "$root/runtime" ji-host
docker run --rm -v "$root:/work" -v "$HOME/ji-stage6-release/generate-private-host-bundle.mjs:/generate.mjs:ro" \
  node:24.20.0-bookworm node /generate.mjs /work/output/ji-host-failed-health.tar.gz /work/output/signature \
  0.1.0-stage6-failed-health linux x64
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_FAILED_HEALTH_FIXTURE_OK
